# Design System

> What this design system is and how to use it.

## Overview

- [Overview](/): What this design system is and how to use it.
- [Principles](/principles): The five decisions that shape every other decision in this system.
- [Components](/components): The shadcn/ui components we use. Each links to the canonical docs.

## Foundations

- [Preset](/foundations/preset): The shadcn preset is the source of truth for every foundation token in this system.
- [Spacing](/foundations/spacing): Four ranks — page, card, fields, inline — cover almost every spacing decision.

## Patterns

- [Mobile adaptation](/patterns/mobile-adaptation): How to translate desktop patterns to mobile without just shrinking them.
- [Forms](/patterns/forms): Layout, validation, and submission patterns for forms.
- [Empty states](/patterns/empty-states): What a view looks like before any data exists, and what to do about it.
- [Error handling](/patterns/error-handling): How we surface errors across inline, page-level, and global scopes.
- [Confirmations](/patterns/confirmations): When to confirm, how to confirm, and when not to.

## Writing

- [Voice](/writing/voice): How we sound across the product.
- [Writing style](/writing/writing-style): Capitalisation, punctuation, numbers, and dates.
- [UX copy](/writing/ux-copy): Patterns for buttons, empty states, errors, and confirmations.
